title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
abstract: arXiv:2608.02575v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Digital learning systems consume concrete pseudorandom values rather than abstract random variables. These values enter the realized loss and its gradient during training. If a pseudorandom stream contains structure that is accessible to the model, this structure can therefore become part of what the learning system learns. We show that this effect can be strong enough to change generation quality in diffusion models. For diffusion noise prediction, there are two related routes by which the loss can be reduced. The model can learn regularities of the clean data and use them to infer the added noise. It can also exploit regularities of the noise source itself to recover the realized noise from the noisy input. Random-role ablation shows that the dominant source-dependent effect in our experiments is associated with the diffusion-noise roles. translated_title: 扩散模型中的伪随机流作为可学习输入影响生成质量
translated_abstract: 数字学习系统消耗的是具体的伪随机值，而非抽象的随机变量。这些值在训练期间进入实际损失及其梯度。如果伪随机流包含模型可访问的结构，那么这种结构就可能成为学习系统所学内容的一部分。我们证明，这种效应足以改变扩散模型的生成质量。对于扩散噪声预测，存在两条相关途径可减少损失：模型可以学习干净数据的规律性并利用它们推断添加的噪声，也可以利用噪声源本身的规律性从噪声输入中恢复实际噪声。随机角色消融实验表明，在我们实验中主要的源相关效应与扩散噪声角色相关。一种去除可重用真实图像结构的扩散探针仍显示出明显的源依赖性。
tldr: 本文发现扩散模型中的伪随机流若包含可学习结构，会被模型利用以降低损失，从而显著影响生成质量，且这种效应主要源于扩散噪声角色的可预测性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that pseudorandom streams in diffusion models, if containing learnable structure, can be exploited by the model to reduce loss, significantly affecting generation quality, with the effect primarily arising from the predictability of diffusion-noise roles.
